Study Grove focus timer

Study Grove is a countdown timer over a voxel landscape. It starts with 25 minutes of focus and 5 minutes of break, and it pauses the game while it is open.

Voxelgame main dd29d91 · 3 min read · Everyone · feature ledger · all guides

Open Study Grove

  1. In a world, press P.
  2. On the start menu, click Study timer.
  3. Press P while you type in a search or name box and nothing opens. On the Worlds page, P also does nothing, so you can type a world name.

The world stops while Study Grove is open. In survival your needs and the world clock are paused too. Close it with Esc or Back. Study Grove focus timer

Start and pause the timer

The timer starts paused. Press Space or click Start / resume to run it, and Pause to stop it.

Key or actionWhat it does
SpaceStart or pause the timer.
Tab or Arrow keysMove to the next or previous button.
EnterPress the selected button.
Esc or BackLeave Study Grove. The timer pauses.
  • Reset phase starts the current phase again from the beginning.
  • To break and To study switch phase at once. A switch does not count as a finished focus session.
  • The count of finished focus sessions is shown while Study Grove is open. It only goes up when a focus phase runs to the end.
  • A chime plays when a phase changes. Near the end of a break you hear a reminder 30 seconds before it ends. Study Grove focus timer

Change the lengths

  • Focus has - and + buttons. It goes from 5 to 90 minutes in steps of 5. The default is 25.
  • Break has - and + buttons. It goes from 1 to 30 minutes in steps of 1. The default is 5.

While the timer is paused, a change to a length applies at once. While it runs, the new length applies when the next phase starts.

Chimes, music, auto-next and animation

  • Chimes turns the phase chimes and the break reminder on or off. On by default.
  • Music plays the music playlist while Study Grove is open, even when Music is off in Settings. Your Settings choice comes back when you leave. On by default.
  • Auto-next starts the next phase by itself when one ends. Turn it off to stop at the end of each phase. On by default.
  • Animation moves the scenery. Turn it off to hold the scene still. On by default.
  • Weather changes the look of the landscape: Clear, Rain, Snow or Sunset. It does not change your world's weather.
Planned, not in the game. Planned: a small album-art picture beside the song title. Today the song title shows in Study Grove only as text. Now playing display with album art

Study over your own world

Click Backdrop to switch from the landscape to Backdrop: Real terrain. The timer then sits over your actual world, so you can study with your builds in view. Study over your own world (Real terrain backdrop)

  • Camera: Your view keeps the viewpoint you had.
  • Camera: Slow orbit turns slowly about 12 m around that point, above the treetops. Turn Animation off to hold it still.
  • Weather cycles through World, Clear, Rain, Mist and Sunset. The world's saved weather does not change.
  • Options shows every timer control over the compact timer. In the compact view, the other controls stay hidden until you click Options.

Your player, needs and clock stay paused. Leaving Study Grove puts your normal view back. Switching the backdrop resets the weather choice and closes Options.

What to know

  • Study Grove always runs at about 30 frames per second, whatever the frame limit is set to. Frame limit
  • The settings and the finished-session count reset when you restart the game or change world.
Planned, not in the game. Planned: keeping the screen awake during long sessions. Today your system's power settings decide when the screen dims. Keep the display awake while playing
